verdict.rationale: MX documents a ready-made, embeddable Connect Widget that prompts end users to connect to their institutions, so developers don't build institution UI. It ships Web and React Native SDKs and gives guidance on OAuth handling in WebViews, which covers the 'open the widget' part well. Missing for 10: documentation of server-side session/widget-URL creation, documentation of the token or identifier returned for the connected account on success, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
